artifacts.name: ALZ-OPSDEV-APP-PEP

artifacts.name: M3-AFD-ISTP-D-1
details: PLANNED — not yet deployed. Owned and provisioned by the network team, outside this repo's Terraform (same pattern as vnet/subnets).
Public HTTPS entry point: global routing, TLS termination, caching for the ISTP external portal.
Tier TBD: Standard supports custom WAF rules only; Premium adds Microsoft-managed rule sets and bot protection.
Origin should target the app via private link / IP restriction, not a public endpoint.

Now auto-picked-up: infra/scripts/generate_tf_config.py and generate_infra_inventory.py in the ISTP repo were extended to read network.json's optional front_door_name/waf_policy_name fields, same as vnet_name/subnets. Once the network team provisions these and the values are added to infra/common/network.json, the next generator run emits this artifact automatically — no further code changes needed.

artifacts.name: M3-AFDWAF-ISTP-D-1
details: PLANNED — not yet deployed. Owned and provisioned by the network team, outside this repo's Terraform.
Mode TBD: start in Detection to tune rules, then switch to Prevention before go-live.
Managed rule sets (OWASP, bot protection) require Front Door Premium; Standard tier is custom-rules-only.

stages.name: Generate

stages.name: Plan / Apply

stages.name: AppBuild
stages.text: Builds/pushes frontend and backend container images, restarts both web apps.

boundaryNotes.title: Network is externally owned
boundaryNotes.text: The VNet, subnets, NSGs, and route tables in M3-RG-ALZ-OPSDEV-D-1 are owned by the infrastructure team. This repo only consumes subnet IDs via data sources.

boundaryNotes.title: Private DNS zones must be linked by the infra team
boundaryNotes.text: Private endpoints are deployed by this repo but name resolution requires privatelink DNS zones linked to M3-ALZ-VNET-OPSDEV-D-1. Coordinate with the infrastructure team.

boundaryNotes.title: APIM subnet is reserved
boundaryNotes.text: ALZ-OPSDEV-APP-APPS is reserved for a future APIM gateway. It is not consumed by this workload.

boundaryNotes.title: Front Door and WAF are planned, not deployed
boundaryNotes.text: front-door and waf are shown as target-state artifacts for the ISTP external-portal requirement. Neither exists yet — they will be manually created by the network team, the same as the VNet and subnets. The ISTP repo's generate_tf_config.py and generate_infra_inventory.py have been updated to treat front_door_name/waf_policy_name in infra/common/network.json as optional external-network fields (mirroring vnet_name/subnets), so once the network team provisions them and those names are recorded, the next pipeline run picks them up automatically with no further code changes.
